title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Remote)
description: Who We Are (Mode.Inc) Mode.Inc is the parent company of a portfolio of technology businesses, including Mode Mobile, the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software platform that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users worldwide to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, and shopping. We enable users to profit from their data and attention, rather than letting only tech giants benefit. What sets us apart is our inclusive approach, converting users into earners, facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings, and going a step further by turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in Mode.Inc based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries. Mode Mobile, Inc. Ranked Number 1 Fastest Growing Company in North America on the 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500. For additional insights, check out information about our reward-based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine for our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone. Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success. You can read more about our team and how we work here. The Role We're looking for an exceptional Sr. Backend Engineer to help build, scale, and evolve the backend systems powering our consumer-facing mobile products. You'll architect reliable services, increase speed and resilience, optimize infrastructure, and unlock new features that help users achieve goals and earn points more effectively. You'll architect reliable services, increase speed and resilience, optimize infrastructure, and unlock new features that help users achieve goals and earn points more effectively. This is a hands-on, high-impact role ideal for someone who loves solving complex systems problems, building scalable APIs, and shipping features that directly impact product performance and user experience. You will collaborate closely with product, design, data, and frontend engineering to deliver features through rapid development cycles and deployment. Who You Are and What You'll Do Build & Scale Core Services Architect backend systems powering user workflows, notifications, and automation features Design APIs and microservices built for performance, efficiency, and scale Quickly learn and apply new technologies as needed Work with high-volume data systems and event-driven architectures Improve observability, monitoring, logging, testing, and alerting Identify performance bottlenecks and implement optimization strategies Build distributed systems with multiple services, queues, external APIs, and asynchronous data flows Ensure uptime, stability, and production resilience Build resilient integrations with third-party services Work in 2-week sprints with CI/CD and strong code quality practices Partner with product, data, and frontend to ship features Participate in system design and architecture reviews What You Bring to the Team 6+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally in consumer apps, mobile, or SaaS, with at least 2 years in a senior-level role Expert-level proficiency in Ruby on Rails, including modern versions and best practices (this is central to the role) Hands-on production experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and performance tuning Strong expertise with Sidekiq for background job processing, including scheduling, throttling, batching, and reliability patterns Proficiency using Redis for caching, job queues, and distributed locking Experience with DynamoDB or comparable NoSQL databases Solid background in API design, RESTful principles, versioning, and serialization Proven track record of integrating with third-party APIs and external services Experience designing, building, and scaling distributed systems in production Familiarity with AWS services, including S3, DynamoDB, SQS, CloudWatch, and SES Strong skills in testing, CI/CD pipelines, logging/monitoring, debugging, and performance optimization Ability to work in a fast-moving remote startup environment Preferred Experience building and supporting backends for mobile apps Experience creating internal tools or admin panels with ActiveAdmin Hands-on work with Shoryuken for SQS message processing Experience integrating payment processors like Stripe Nice to Have : Event-driven or streaming architecture AI-assisted/AI agentic development (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) Feature flagging, experimentation, or A/B testing Alignment with our core values: Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement. Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done. Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment. Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve. Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance. How You Work Take ownership and deliver reliably Quickly pick up unfamiliar technologies and move between systems Think beyond the code and care about product outcomes Communicate clearly, asynchronously, and proactively Value craftsmanship, testing, and system reliability Enjoy learning, improving, and making things better over time We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms Allow OKRs to Guide Us Assume Positive Intent Agree to Disagree & Commit Set New Precedents Accomplish More with Less Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards Speak Up Be Resourceful Follow the 80/20 Rule What We Are Offering We are a 100% remote-first, global company. A competitive compensation package. We offer generous perks & benefits to team members. Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members). We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program. Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people. Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones. Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies. Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment. Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings). Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members). If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together! Mode.Inc does not accept/pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Senior PHP Developer
description: PHP Developer Full Remote Role Description As a PHP Developer at our customer, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining software solutions. Leveraging your expertise in backend, frontend, and infrastructure development, you will contribute to every development lifecycle stage. We seek a professional with strong technical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to delivering high-quality, sustainable solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design innovative solutions. Optimize application performance and system architecture. Ensure high code quality and maintainability through adherence to best practices. Skillset RequirementsBackend Development: Proficient in PHP with extensive experience in Symfony Framework . Skilled in using PHPSpec for behavior-driven development and PHPStan for static code analysis. Strong knowledge of MySQL for efficient database management. Experience with Redis for caching and session management. Frontend Development: Proficient in JavaScript with hands-on experience in modern frameworks. Expertise in VueJS or NuxtJS for building interactive and scalable front-end applications. API Development: Strong experience in reading and writing OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) for API design and documentation. Proficient in GraphQL for writing queries, mutations, and subscriptions. DevOps & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization and managing environments. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for automating build, test, and deployment workflows. Key Competencies Strong knowledge of software development best practices, including SOLID principles and design patterns. Proficient in version control systems like Git . Familiarity with testing frameworks and tools. Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and a focus on code quality. Experience with scalable system architectures and performance optimization techniques. Soft Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Turkish. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Application Process: If you meet the requirements of this role and would like to find out more about this opportunity, please apply to role with an updated CV.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Data & Trading Infrastructure)
description: İş İlanı Hakkında Data Engineering | Ultra Low-Latency | Trading Infrastructure Hakkımızda : Algosense, finansal piyasalarda algoritmik işlem ve veri altyapısı çözümleri geliştiren bir teknoloji şirketidir. Faaliyet alanımız, düşük gecikmeyle çalışan emir iletim sistemlerinden, yüksek hacimli piyasa verisinin güvenilir biçimde toplanması, saklanması ve işlenmesine kadar uzanan kritik bir mühendislik sahasını kapsamaktadır. Doğru kararın milisaniyeler içinde alınması gereken bu alanda, hem sistem güvenilirliğine hem de performansa eş zamanlı olarak odaklanan, derin teknik uzmanlığa sahip mühendislerle çalışmayı önemsiyoruz. Pozisyon Hakkında: Bu pozisyonda, AlgoSense'in emir iletim sisteminin ve finansal verinin saklanması ile işlenmesinden sorumlu çekirdek backend servislerini tasarlayacak, ölçeklendirecek ve operasyonel olarak işleteceksiniz. Sistemin omurgasını oluşturan, doğrudan kritik veri yollarına temas eden bir ekipte; mimari kararların alınmasından üretim ortamının sürdürülebilirliğine kadar uçtan uca sorumluluk üstleneceksiniz. Aynı zamanda, teknik yönlendirme ve ekip içi bilgi paylaşımı yoluyla mühendislik kültürünün gelişimine katkı sağlamanızı bekliyoruz. Sorumluluklar: •⁠ ⁠Emir iletim sisteminin (order management ve order routing) backend bileşenlerini, düşük gecikme hedefleri doğrultusunda tasarlamak, geliştirmek ve optimize etmek •⁠ ⁠Hisse senedi, türev, döviz ve kripto gibi farklı varlık sınıflarına ait piyasa ve işlem verisini güvenilir, tutarlı ve sorgulanabilir biçimde saklayan veri katmanını (time-series ve ilişkisel) kurgulamak •⁠ ⁠Kafka tabanlı olay akışları üzerinde dayanıklı, sıralı ve kayıpsız veri işleme hatları tasarlamak ve işletmek •⁠ ⁠Redis/Dragonfly çözümleriyle düşük gecikmeli önbellekleme ve in-memory veri yapıları geliştirmek •⁠ ⁠Yüksek veri hacmi (high throughput) ve düşük gecikme (low latency) gereksinimleri arasındaki dengeyi gözeterek sistem performansını sürekli iyileştirmek •⁠ ⁠Dağıtık sistemlerde veri tutarlılığı, idempotency ve hata toleransı gerektiren senaryoları uçtan uca çözümmek •⁠ ⁠Servislerin gözlemlenebilirliğini (metrik, log ve izleme) ve operasyonel güvenilirliğini güçlendirmek •⁠ ⁠Mimari kararlar ve teknik yön konusunda ekibe rehberlik etmek; kod kalitesi ve mühendislik standartlarının yükseltilmesine öncülük etmek Aradığımız Nitelikler: •⁠ ⁠Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili bir mühendislik bölümünden lisans derecesi •⁠ ⁠Backend geliştirme alanında ‘5+ yıl’ profesyonel deneyim •⁠ ⁠Python, C# ve *C++’ dillerinde üretim seviyesinde geliştirme deneyimi •⁠ ⁠PostgreSQL ve TimescaleDB (veya muadili time-series teknolojileri) ile üretim ortamında çalışmış olmak; ileri düzey veri modelleme ve sorgu optimizasyonu yetkinliği •⁠ ⁠Kafka veya benzeri mesajlaşma/streaming sistemlerinin tasarımı ve operasyonu konusunda deneyim •⁠ ⁠Redis / Dragonfly ile önbellekleme ve in-memory veri yönetimi tecrübesi •⁠ ⁠Her türlü finansal enstrümanın (hisse, türev, döviz, kripto vb.) fiyat verisini işleyen, yüksek hacimli (high throughput) ve düşük gecikmeli (low latency) sistemlerin tasarımı ve işletimi konusunda kanıtlanmış deneyim •⁠ ⁠Dağıtık sistemlerde tutarlılık, dayanıklılık ve performans arasındaki dengeyi kurabilme yetkinliği •⁠ ⁠Teknik konuları hem ekip içinde hem de farklı paydaşlarla net, anlaşılır ve etkili biçimde paylaşabilen güçlü iletişim becerisi; iş birliğine açık ve sonuç odaklı çalışma yaklaşımı Tercih Sebepleri: •⁠ ⁠Finansal piyasalar, emir iletimi (örneğin FIX protokolü) veya trading altyapısı alanında deneyim •⁠ ⁠Olay tabanlı mimari (event-driven / CQRS) ile pratik tecrübe •⁠ ⁠Performans profilleme ve düşük gecikme optimizasyonu konusunda derinlik •⁠ ⁠Container ve orkestrasyon teknolojileri (Docker, Kubernetes) ile CI/CD süreçlerine hâkimiyet •⁠ ⁠Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili alanlarda yüksek lisans derecesi Sunduklarımız : •⁠ ⁠Rekabetçi maaş ve performans bonusu •⁠ ⁠Özel sağlık sigortası •⁠ ⁠Yıllık eğitim ve konferans bütçesi •⁠ ⁠En son teknoloji ekipmanlar •⁠ ⁠Finansal piyasalar üzerine sürekli öğrenme ortamı Başvuru : CV'nizi, GitHub profilinizi ve daha önce çalıştığınız trading/fintech projelerinizin detaylarını içeren başvurularınızı bekliyoruz. Mikro saniyelerin önemli olduğu sistemlere imza atmak isteyenlerle tanışmayı dört gözle bekliyoruz!

title: Mid-level React Native Developer

Yayındaki uygulamalarımızda doğrudan sorumluluk alacak, aynı zamanda sıfırdan hayata geçecek projelerin temelini bizimle birlikte atma fırsatın olacak. 🚀 Aradığımız Profil 2+ yıl profesyonel React Native deneyimi , yayınlanmış uygulamalarda aktif rol almış Mobil uygulama geliştirme, performans optimizasyonu ve debugging konusunda tecrübeli Modern JavaScript ( ESNext ) ve TypeScript hakkında derin bilgi sahibi UI/UX detaylarına önem veren , pixel-perfect tasarımları hayata geçirme konusunda titiz Üçüncü parti kütüphane ve SDK entegrasyonlarına hâkim Temiz, ölçeklenebilir ve yeniden kullanılabilir component mimarisi kurabilen RESTful mimari, WebSocket ve HTTP metodları konusunda derin bilgi sahibi Versiyon kontrol sistemleri, özellikle Git konusunda deneyimli App Store ve Google Play Store ’a uygulama yükleme süreçlerinde tecrübeli Startup ortamında proaktif, sorumluluk alan ve hızlı öğrenmeye açık 🛠️ Nelerle Çalışıyoruz? React Native CLI | JavaScript & TypeScript State Management: Jotai / Zustand / React Query Networking: RESTful API & WebSocket Üçüncü parti SDK & servis entegrasyonları (Firebase, Meta, ödeme sistemleri vb.) Git & Git Flow Xcode & Android Studio 💡 “Ekibimdeki insanları iş arkadaşından çok ailem gibi görebilirim, sıfırdan bir şeyler inşa etmeye hevesliyim.” diyorsan seni aramızda görmekten mutluluk duyarız.

title: Development Team Lead (Full-Stack — Backend Heavy)
description: At Mobiva, we build AI-powered consumer applications across iOS, Android, and web, and scale them globally. We're an AI app studio that places the latest text, image, video, and audio models at the core of our products; product, technology, growth, and monetization are developed entirely in-house. We're looking for a teammate to lead our growing development team (mobile, backend, and QA) while also taking technical ownership of the backend. This is a "player-coach" role: Your priority will be leading the team and delivering work end-to-end together with the product team — but we're looking for someone who thinks full-stack and enjoys getting hands-on with code when it's needed and during intense periods. We work at a pace that ships a product every sprint, and we make our decisions by reading the numbers. This role is the technical owner of that pace. What you'll do Lead the development team across mobile, backend, and QA; grow and mentor the team Set priorities with the product team, plan the work in Linear, and deliver complete and on time every sprint Own architecture and API decisions as the technical lead of the backend; solve problems quickly and share the reasoning with the team Own the backend layer that brings AI models (text, image, video, audio) into the product: provider integrations, queueing and processing flows, latency and error handling Manage model cost on the technical side: set up rate limits, usage/credit limits, and free-tier constraints together with the product team Guarantee that the subscription and paywall infrastructure (RevenueCat, Adapty, Web2Wave) and the event/analytics implementation work correctly — we don't ship a feature whose measurement isn't in place Own code quality, code review culture, and technical standards Mature the team's AI-driven development practice — build the review, testing, and standards that reduce AI-introduced defects while keeping the speed gains Make rapid prototyping technically possible in a field where new models and capabilities ship weekly Contribute hands-on development on the mobile and web side when needed Work alongside DevOps on deployment and infrastructure processes What we're looking for 5+ years of software development and team leadership/mentoring experience (maturity and capability matter more than an exact year count) Command of the modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem and strong backend development experience with NestJS/Node Experience designing the right API and communication model for the problem (REST/GraphQL, real-time, event-driven) Experience with versioning and backward compatibility in APIs serving mobile applications Experience with PostgreSQL schema design, performance optimization, and migration management Full-stack capability at a level where you can actively develop with React Native (Expo) and Next.js Hands-on production experience with AI/LLM APIs (streaming, asynchronous processing, cost and latency management) Command of servers, domain/DNS, and deployment processes (enough to speak the same language as DevOps) Technical judgment to pick the right tool for the job, and an approach that owns work end-to-end Experience working with a product team, prioritizing, and carrying delivery responsibility Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and the ability to operate at a pace that ships every sprint Good level of English What would excite us Experience at a mobile app studio or product company Experience working on consumer AI products Experience on large-scale, high-download, "winner" products Experience with mobile marketing technologies (attribution, analytics, growth & A/B testing, ASO, push/CRM) Subscription/monetization backend (RevenueCat, Adapty, Web2Wave, IAP), Firebase (Analytics/Crashlytics/Remote Config), release management with feature flags Experience with event taxonomy and attribution implementation on the Amplitude/AppsFlyer/Firebase side Experience building heavy media processing (image/video generation) pipelines Active use of AI-assisted development tools What describes you Calm in a crisis — focused on the fix rather than the panic when a system goes down Strong communicator — shares good news and bad news transparently and on time Fast, pragmatic problem solver who takes ownership Comfortable in an environment where decisions are made quickly, transparently, and based on data Adaptable to a fast-changing AI landscape — the technology shifts weekly, and you can keep up Eager to learn, genuinely enjoys the work, and spreads that energy across the team Our tool set Backend & full-stack: TypeScript, NestJS/Node, PostgreSQL, React Native (Expo), Next.js Planning & task tracking: Linear Monetization & subscriptions: RevenueCat, Adapty, Web2Wave Analytics & measurement: Amplitude, Firebase Attribution & growth: AppsFlyer, Adjust Why Mobiva The opportunity to build the most trending AI products in the global market and bring them to millions of users The chance to work daily with the latest text, image, video, and audio models in an AI-first culture An iteration speed traditional companies can't match for years A fast but disciplined development pace built around shipping a product every sprint Close collaboration with product, AI, growth, and marketing teams A strong company culture we actively work on every day — every team member is both a participant in and a builder of it All products are developed in-house, end to end
